# namespace_cache_volume_summary (Data Source)

Reads tag-level summary and generation metadata for Namespace cache volumes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_cache_volume_summary" "build_cache" {
  tag = "ci-build-cache"
}

output "cache_volume_stats" {
  description = "Summary metrics for cache volume"
  value = {
    size_mb     = data.namespace_cache_volume_summary.build_cache.size_mb
    generations = length(data.namespace_cache_volume_summary.build_cache.generations)
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (String) Volume tag to query.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of when the volume tag was first created.
- `generations` (Attributes List) List of cache volume generations associated with this tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--generations))
- `id` (String) Identifier for the data source, matching the volume tag.
- `size_mb` (Number) Requested size of the volume tag in megabytes.

<a id="nestedatt--generations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `generations`

Read-Only:

- `attached_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when attached.
- `attached_to` (String) Compute instance ID the volume was attached to.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `destroyed_at` (String) RFC3339 destruction timestamp, if destroyed.
- `detached_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when detached.
- `generation_reason` (String) Reason this cache volume generation was started.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this cache volume generation.
- `size_mb` (Number) Volume size in megabytes.
- `state` (String) Volume lifecycle state (e.g. STATE_IN_USE, STATE_AT_REST, STATE_EXPIRED, STATE_ABANDONED).
- `tag` (String) Volume tag name.
- `used_mb_when_attached` (Number) Data used on volume when attached in megabytes.
- `used_mb_when_detached` (Number) Data used on volume when detached in megabytes.
